title: 第五章 吃人不吐骨头的魔宗第六章 防不胜防
content_zh:
听到那灰白道袍青年漫不经心的话语，苏阎腮帮子上的肌肉抽动了一下。
五十点？
他初入外门，按照规矩发放的初始福利也不过才区区一百点，这连洞府的门槛都还没迈进去，就已经被强行剥削去了一半。
这万骨宗，哪里是什么令人心生向往、求仙问道的修仙圣地？这分明就是一个彻头彻尾、吃人不吐骨头的魔窟！
万骨宗的高层，根本就是把所有底层弟子当成了毫无尊严的耗材，将他们一股脑地丢进这个巨大无比的蛊盅里。
用那虚无缥缈却又掌控生死的“贡献点”作为无形的锁链，死死勒住每一个人的脖颈，逼着他们去拼命，去疯狂厮杀。
在这里，没有任何温情可言，更没有所谓的宗门庇护。
你不去干活，不去拼命压榨自己的最后一点价值，下场就只有死，而且会死得无比凄惨。
苏阎没多废话，抓起衣服和令牌，转身走出偏殿。
山风倒灌进领口，带来一丝凉意。
他将真气注入手中的令牌，一丝微弱的热流顺着掌心反馈回来，在脑海中勾勒出一条模糊的路线。
随后苏阎扛着少女，顺着路线往阴阳殿的后山走去。
越往深处走，周遭的植被越发稀疏，取而代之的是大片大片裸露的黑褐色岩石。
空气里的湿度逐渐攀升，带着一股常年不见天日的霉味。
小半个时辰后，临近日落，苏阎站在山脚处的一座偏僻洞府前。
在以这座洞府为中心的方圆百丈之内，还错落有致地分布着数十个大小不一的洞府，但大多数都是闲置空缺的。
石门紧闭，门前杂草丛生，显然已经很久没有活人居住过了。
苏阎收回目光，将令牌按在石门中央的凹槽里。
沉重的石门缓缓往上抬起，扑面而来的是一股浓烈的灰尘与腐败气息。
洞府内部的空间极小，顶多也就十来个平方。

四面全是粗糙的石壁，连打磨的工序都省了。
靠里的角落砌着一张冰冷的石床，床脚边摆着一张缺了个角的木桌。
除此之外，空无一物。
连个蒲团都没有。
苏阎环顾四周，皱了皱眉：“就这破洞府，每个月还要五十贡献点？”
他一把将肩上的少女拽下来，随手往地上一扔。
扑通。
少女重重地摔在满是灰尘的石板地上。
粗糙的地面瞬间擦破了她的手掌和膝盖，渗出丝丝血迹，疼痛让她从浑噩中惊醒。
少女看着周围幽闭昏暗的石室，以及站在阴影中犹如恶鬼般的苏阎，极度的恐惧彻底击穿了她的心理防线。
她手脚并用，拼命往后退，直到后背死死抵住冰冷的石壁，退无可退，她才停了下来。
双手紧紧抱住膝盖，把头埋在臂弯里，喉咙里发出断断续续的呜咽，整个人抖得像风中的落叶。
苏阎并未理会她，能把她带回来，没有留在那杂役院，已经算是不错的了。
毕竟那地方的折磨，他可是真实的感受过的。
苏阎走到石床边坐下，再次端详起那块黑铁令牌。
令牌的背面，刻着苏阎二字。
名字下方，多出了一道繁复的符文。
神念探入符文。
脑海中立刻浮现出一个数字：五十。
按照刚才那登记青年的说法，新晋弟子初始会发放一百点贡献点作为福利。

现在只剩下五十点，说明那破洞府的租金已经自动扣除了。
content_en:
Hearing the casual words of the young man in gray and white robes, the muscles on Su Yan's cheeks twitched.
Fifty o'clock?
When he first entered the outer gate, the initial benefits distributed according to the rules were only a mere hundred points. He had already been forcibly exploited half of it before he even stepped through the threshold of the cave.
Where is this Ten Thousand Bones Sect, a holy land for cultivating immortals that makes people yearn for it and ask for immortality? This is clearly a devil's cave that eats people without spitting out their bones!
The senior officials of Ten Thousand Bones Sect simply regarded all the lower-level disciples as consumables without dignity and threw them all into this huge vise.
Use that illusory "contribution point" that controls life and death as an invisible chain to strangle everyone's neck, forcing them to fight desperately and fight crazily.
There is no warmth at all here, let alone the so-called protection of the sect.
If you don't work and squeeze out the last bit of your own value, the only outcome will be death, and it will be an extremely miserable death.
Su Yan didn't waste any more words, grabbed his clothes and token, turned around and walked out of the side hall.
The mountain breeze poured into the neckline, bringing a bit of coolness.
He poured his true energy into the token in his hand, and a faint stream of heat flowed back along his palm, drawing a vague route in his mind.
Then Su Yan carried the girl and walked along the route to the back mountain of Yin Yang Palace.
As you go deeper, the surrounding vegetation becomes sparse and replaced by large expanses of exposed dark brown rocks.
The humidity in the air is gradually rising, carrying a musty smell that has not seen the light of day all year round.
Half an hour later, as sunset approached, Su Yan stood in front of a remote cave at the foot of the mountain.
Within a hundred feet radius centered on this cave, there are dozens of caves of different sizes scattered in an orderly manner, but most of them are idle and vacant.
The stone door was closed, and there were overgrown weeds in front of it. It was obvious that no one had lived there for a long time.
Su Yan withdrew his gaze and pressed the token into the groove in the center of the stone door.
The heavy stone door slowly lifted up, and a strong smell of dust and corruption hit the face.
The space inside the cave is extremely small, only about ten square meters at most.
It is surrounded by rough stone walls, and even the polishing process is omitted.
A cold stone bed was built in the back corner, and a wooden table with a corner missing stood at the foot of the bed.
Other than that, there is nothing.
Not even a futon.
Su Yan looked around and frowned: "Just this broken cave house, you still need fifty contribution points every month?"
He pulled the girl off his shoulders and threw her to the ground.
thump.
The girl fell heavily onto the dusty stone floor.
The rough ground instantly scratched her palms and knees, and traces of blood oozed out. The pain woke her up from a daze.
The girl looked at the claustrophobic and dark stone room around her and Su Yan, who stood in the shadow like a ghost. Extreme fear completely penetrated her psychological defense.
She used her hands and feet to move back as hard as she could. She didn't stop until her back was firmly pressed against the cold stone wall and there was no way to retreat.
He hugged his knees tightly with his hands, buried his head in his arms, and sobbed intermittently from his throat, his whole body shaking like a fallen leaf in the wind.
Su Yan ignored her. It was good to be able to bring her back instead of staying in the miscellaneous yard.
After all, he had truly experienced the torture in that place.
Su Yan walked to the stone bed and sat down, looking at the black iron token again.
On the back of the token, the word Su Yan is engraved.
Under the name, there is a complicated rune.
Divine thoughts penetrated the runes.
A number immediately came to mind: fifty.
According to what the registered young man said just now, new disciples will initially be given one hundred contribution points as benefits.
Now there are only fifty points left, which means that the rent of the cave house has been automatically deducted.
